68. (C) FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE ON THE NATURAL DEATH OF A 
DIFFERENTLY  
ABLED PERSON 
 
 
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
A sum of Rs.15,000/- is given as assistance on the 
natural death of a differently abled person. 
2. 
Eligibility Criteria 
Member of the Welfare board for the differently 
abled. 
3. 
Whether the prescribed 
application form is available 
Yes. Available with District Differently Abled 
Welfare Office. 
4. 
Certificates to be furnished 
Death certificate, legal heir certificate and original 
national identity card for differently abled and 
original  identity card issued by the welfare board for 
the differently abled. 
5. 
Officer to whom the 
application is to be submitted 
District Differently Abled Welfare Officer 
6. 
Grievances if any to 
be addressed to 
Assistant Director (DAW), 
O/o. The Commissionerate  for Welfare of the 
Differently abled, 
No.5, Kamarajar salai, 
Chennai – 600 005.  
Ph: 044-28444940
